description: Use when you need the official text of a South Korean statute, decree or rule, or one article of it. Statutes only: no court decisions or personal data. Input: q (statute name in Korean, e.g. 근로기준법) or mst (law serial no.), optional article (e.g. 2), limit (articles, 1-100, default 30). Output: JSON law metadata (ministry, effective date), articles [{label,title,text}] in original Korean, official URL, attribution. Example: ?q=근로기준법&article=2 Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

article.description: Single article number, e.g. 2 or 제2조

limit.description: Max articles when no article is given (default 30)

mst.description: 법령일련번호 (law serial number) from a previous answer

q.description: Statute name in Korean (exact name preferred), e.g. 근로기준법. Required unless mst is given.

name: kr_law
title: Korean statute text by name or article (Ministry of Government Legislation), unaltered with attribution
